UP MLA Kamal Akhtar Resigns as Chief Whip of Legislative Assembly

Samajwadi Party MLA Kamal Akhtar has resigned from his position as chief whip of the legislative assembly in Uttar Pradesh. The decision comes amid controversy surrounding a dispute with MP Ruchi Veera and increasing tensions within the party. The resignation is seen as a response to the opposition's growing pressure.
